title: Fear golems: Dread, Fright and Terror
summary: Dread and Fright use recurring Death Touch; all three golems can leave a broodling behind.
overview: Dread and Fright use recurring Death Touch; all three golems can leave a broodling behind.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Have the pull and recovery plan ready before engaging Dread or Fright: the first Death Touch can occur almost immediately.
Further Death Touch casts repeat every forty-five seconds against the top-threat target.
A pet at the top of the hate list redirects the cast to its owner; the script also removes listed divine-aura protections.
After any golem dies, check for the possible iksar broodling.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
The reviewed source is standard or unversioned; this draft applies to version 0.
Terror's reviewed script has the broodling branch but no scripted Death Touch loop; database spells were not reviewed.
